note: Hand-curated. No turning figure may be used without its turningMeasure alongside it: radius and diameter get confused constantly, and kerb-to-kerb and wall-to-wall are neither the same measurement nor fed into the same formula. See src/vehicle.js.

turningMeasures.kerb-diameter: Diameter of the circle described by the outer front wheel. The figure manufacturers publish most often.
turningMeasures.kerb-radius: The same, but given as a radius.
turningMeasures.wall-diameter: Diameter of the circle described by the outer front corner of the bodywork. Always larger than the kerb figure.
turningMeasures.wall-radius: The same, but given as a radius.
